caption: Annual prefilter keep rate, 2021-2025.
notes: Proportion of eligible Q1/Q2 records retained by the AI-engagement prefilter as discourse or evaluative. Year is the first four-digit year in the PubMed date field. 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples, seed 42). Spearman ρ=+1.00 (P=.017); OR 1.273 per year (95% CI 1.220-1.329), P<.001. The prefilter audit estimates the false-negative rate among excluded records by year in {{T:prefilter_validation}}.
OR per year: record-level logistic regression on publication year with journal cluster-robust SEs.
